fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) rose 4% to $393.59 following Finland's Full Self-Driving (FSD) approval, with EU-wide approval expected in winter 2026 and Q3 active FSD subscribers at 1.74 million (67% YoY increase).
fields.summary_ko.1: Lucid (LCID) declined 2% to $3.70 on Citi's target price reduction from $11 to $9, Q3 deliveries of 3,806 units (7% YoY decline), with affordable Midsize model delayed to H2 2027; Rivian (RIVN) also fell 0.8% to $13.59.
